data.text:
Saji Thomas vs The Food Safety Officer on 25 June, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas Crl. MC No.4907/2021 1/1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BECHU KURIAN THOMAS  Tuesday, the 25th day of June 2024 / 4th Ashadha, 1946  CRL.M.APPL.NO.1/2021 IN CRL.MC NO. 4907 OF 2021 ST 1713/2020 OF COURT OF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE OF FIRST CLASS , KATTAPPANA, IDUKKI  PETITIONERS/PETITIONERS/ACCUSED NOS 1 TO 6:
 1. SAJI THOMAS, AGED 45 YEARS, S/O.THOMAS, MALIYEKKAL HOUSE, KATTAPPANA  P.O., IDUKKI DISTRICT.
 AND 5 OTHERS.
 RESPONDENTS/COMPLAINANT,STATE & ANOTHER:
 1. THE FOOD SAFETY OFFICER, IDUKKI CIRCLE - 685 608. AND 2 OTHERS. 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the  High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in S.T.1713/2020  pending on the files of Court of the Judicial First Class Magistrate,
 Kattapana pending disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 25/03/2024 in Crl.M.A.1/2021 and  upon hearing the arguments of Mr.PREMJIT NAGENDRAN, Advocates for the  petitioners and the Public Prosecutor for respondents 1 & 2 and  of SANTHAN.V NAIR STANDING COUNSEL for R3, the Court passed the  following:
 ORDER Interim order shall stand extended by six months.
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 25-06-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Saji Thomas vs The Food Safety Officer on 25 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79458895/
